verified_facts.text: Casa San Agustin is a boutique hotel made of three houses inspired by Cartagena's colonial heritage.
verified_facts.excerpt: a boutique hotel made of three houses all inspired by Cartagena’s colonial heritage

verified_facts.text: The hotel occupies three whitewashed colonial buildings in Cartagena's historic center.
verified_facts.excerpt: Three whitewashed colonial buildings with 30 guest rooms and suites in Cartagena's historic center.

verified_facts.text: The interiors feature wooden-beamed ceilings and wall frescos.
verified_facts.excerpt: The wooden-beamed ceilings and wall frescos infuse your stay with the charm of our history

verified_facts.text: The hotel's traditional decoration tells the story of its 17th-century beginnings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Simple but sophisticated traditional decoration tells the story of our 17th century beginnings

verified_facts.text: Stays come with outdoor spaces, luxurious linens and hand-picked amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: the sumptuous comfort of outdoor spaces, luxurious linens, and hand-picked amenities

verified_facts.text: The Aurum Spa's Hammam ritual uses a scrub made of coffee, volcanic mud and pure tobacco after a steam room cleanse.
verified_facts.excerpt: The body is rinsed and cleansed in a moist steam room before a vigorous exfoliation with a scrub made of coffee, volcanic mud and pure tobacco

verified_facts.text: Aurum Spa takes its name from the Latin word for gold.
verified_facts.excerpt: Aurum is the Latin word for “gold” or “brilliant sunrise”.

verified_facts.text: The spa's Time is Gold ritual coats the body in a golden emulsion after a Hammam exfoliation, ending with a facial and body massage.
verified_facts.excerpt: It begins with an exfoliation in the Hammam, followed by coating the body in a shiny, golden emulsion to nourish the skin and ending with a soothing facial and body massage.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers a Cartagena coffee body scrub.
verified_facts.excerpt: CARTAGENA COFFEE BODY SCRUB

verified_facts.text: A couples ritual begins with a soak in the jacuzzi.
